<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 15:31">Targ. O. Num. XV, 31</cite> ed. Berl.; a. fr.; [in ed. sometimes <he>בשר</he>].—

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 11:12">Targ. I Sam. XI, 12</cite> <he>מבסר למימר</he> spoke sneeringly.—Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ bot. <he>בר נש דאימיה מְבַסְּרָא ליה</he> one whom his mother (Palestine) despises and his stepmother (Babylon) honors; v. <cite ref="A01961"><he>אֵם</he></cite>. Y. Snh. I, 19ᵃ top; Y. Ned. VI, 40ᵃ <he>בעא מבסרתהון</he> (<he>מבסרתון</he>; read <he>מבסר בהון</he>) he wanted to despise them (reject their authority).
